text: Think McDonald's makes its money selling burgers?
That's only part of the story.
About ninety-five percent of its restaurants are run by franchisees.
These operators sell the food, but McDonald's collects royalties and, under many franchise agreements, rent.
In 2025, franchise rental revenue was about ten billion dollars. Royalties brought in billions more.
Here's the twist: McDonald's can earn money from a restaurant it doesn't operate.
So those golden arches? They're not just about burgers. They're also about the business behind them.
